subject: Formatting and CSS tips for Shiny 0.11

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Formatting and CSS tips for Shiny 0.11
parts:
With the switch from bootstrap 2 to bootstrap 3 in the latest version of Shiny (0.11) formatting, spacing, alignment, etc. in your app may change. It may be useful to create a thread where we share our findings on how to make changes. Below are a few things I found out. Please add your insights!

=================================================================
To get BS3 styling for a textarea use:

tags$textarea(class="form-control", id="new_look", rows="3")


To put two-numeric inputs side-by-side in Shiny .11 use:

div(class="row",
  div(class="col-xs-6", numericInput("fac1",
     label = "Factor 1:", value = 1),
  div(class="col-xs-6", numericInput("fac2",
     label = "Factor 2:", value = 1),
)

Put the following in your CSS file to ...
Decrease spacing in a well-panel:
.well {
  padding: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}

Narrow the side-bar-panel
.col-sm-4 {
  max-width: 300px;
}

Remove spacing below the navbar if you are using navbarPage
.navbar {
  margin-bottom: 0px;
}

Increase spacing above the output in main-panel:
.nav-tabs {
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Formatting and CSS tips for Shiny 0.11
parts:
A checkboxGroupInput should have a top margin of 0, and a bottom margin of 25px (by virtue of having class="form-group"). You could use a negative margin if you need to further reduce the space.

One more possibility is that your CSS rules are being overridden by other CSS rules due to CSS precedence rules. As Huidong mentioned, using Inspect Element in the browser can reveal the order in which CSS rules are applied.

-Winston

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: Formatting and CSS tips for Shiny 0.11
parts:
Thanks for your input  Huidong and Winston. I have a working css file sourced from ui.R. There are only a few elements in the file and I did check the styles setup in Chrome. I already have .form-group margins set to 0. 

Note: I just found the cause! I had `label` set to "" but checkboxGroupInput requires NULL for label or else it reserves spacing for it.

.checkbox {
  margin-top: 0px;
  margin-bottom: 0px;
}

.form-group {
  margin-top: 0px;
  margin-bottom: 0px;

}

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: Formatting and CSS tips for Shiny 0.11
parts:
Found the solution to eliminate indent for wrapping radio buttons:

.radio-inline+.radio-inline {
    margin-left: 0;
}

.radio-inline {
    margin-right: 10px;
}

Source: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/25730961/bootstrap-radio-inline-line-wrapping-and-stacked-radio-buttons
